Munieh Application

A platform created to help rural women showcase and sell handmade products through a simple, trustworthy digital storefront.

Back to portfolio
View Figma

Project highlights

Built a clean product catalog, simplified browsing, and created a reusable UI kit for categories, product cards, and seller profiles.

UX Research Wireframes UI Kit Prototyping

Problem

Rural artisans often have limited access to markets and rely on word-of-mouth sales. Buyers struggle to discover authentic handmade goods, and sellers need a clear, simple way to present products and build trust.

Case study

Munieh organizes discovery, storytelling, and purchasing into one guided flow. Users browse curated categories, view product details and maker stories, and place orders with fewer steps and clearer expectations.
